name: Brú na Bóinne - Archaeological Ensemble of the Bend of the Boyne
description: Beside a bend in the River Boyne in County Meath, about 50 km north of Dublin, stand three huge passage tombs: Newgrange, Knowth and Dowth. Built around 3200 BC, they are older than Stonehenge and the pyramids, and they hold Europe's richest collection of carved megalithic art. Newgrange is aligned so that winter solstice sunrise lights its inner chamber.
